topics.title: The verb "be": am, is, are
topics.titleFa: فعل be: am، is، are

teach.en: Good morning, class! Let's start with the most important verb in English: "be".
teach.fa: صبح بخیر بچه‌ها! با مهم‌ترین فعل انگلیسی شروع کنیم: «be» (بودن).

teach.en: We say "I am", "he is", "she is", "it is", and "you are", "we are", "they are".
teach.fa: می‌گوییم I am؛ he/she/it is؛ و you/we/they are.

teach.en: In everyday British English we usually shorten it: I'm, he's, she's, it's, you're, we're, they're.
teach.fa: در انگلیسی روزمره معمولاً کوتاهش می‌کنیم: I'm، he's، she's، it's، you're، we're، they're.

teach.en: For the negative, add "not": I'm not, he isn't, they aren't. For a question, swap them round: Is he five?
teach.fa: برای منفی not اضافه کنید: I'm not، he isn't، they aren't. برای سؤال جایشان را عوض کنید: Is he five?

examples.en: I'm Nicola. I'm five.
examples.fa: من نیکولا هستم. پنج سالمه.

examples.en: Tom is a bus driver. He's very funny.
examples.fa: تام رانندهٔ اتوبوس است. او خیلی بامزه است.

examples.en: We aren't late. Are you ready?
examples.fa: ما دیر نکرده‌ایم. آماده‌ای؟

topics.title: this, that, these, those
topics.titleFa: this، that، these، those

teach.en: Use "this" for one thing near you and "that" for one thing far away.
teach.fa: this برای یک چیز نزدیک و that برای یک چیز دور است.

teach.en: For more than one, "this" becomes "these" and "that" becomes "those".
teach.fa: برای جمع، this می‌شود these و that می‌شود those.

teach.en: In shops we point and say: Can I have this one? How much are those?
teach.fa: در مغازه اشاره می‌کنیم و می‌گوییم: Can I have this one? How much are those?

examples.en: This is my brother, Ryan.
examples.fa: این برادرم، رایان است.

examples.en: Those shoes are lovely!
examples.fa: آن کفش‌ها قشنگ‌اند!

examples.en: Are these your keys?
examples.fa: این‌ها کلیدهای توست؟

topics.title: my, your, his, her and 's
topics.titleFa: my، your، his، her و 's

teach.en: Possessive words go before a noun: my, your, his, her, its, our, their.
teach.fa: صفت‌های ملکی قبل از اسم می‌آیند: my، your، his، her، its، our، their.

teach.en: For a person, add 's: Tom's car, Nicola's teddy. With a plural ending in s, add only the apostrophe: my parents' house.
teach.fa: برای مالکیت یک شخص 's اضافه کنید: Tom's car. برای جمعِ مختوم به s فقط آپاستروف: my parents' house.

teach.en: Don't mix up "its" (belonging to it) and "it's" (it is).
teach.fa: its (مال آن) را با it's (آن هست) قاطی نکنید.

examples.en: This is Leslie's kitchen.
examples.fa: این آشپزخانهٔ لزلی است.

examples.en: Their dog is called Biscuit.
examples.fa: اسم سگشان بیسکویت است.

examples.en: The cat is eating its dinner.
examples.fa: گربه دارد شامش را می‌خورد.

topics.title: Plurals: one bus, two buses
topics.titleFa: جمع: one bus، two buses

teach.en: For most nouns, add -s: one book, two books.
teach.fa: برای بیشتر اسم‌ها -s اضافه کنید: one book، two books.

teach.en: After s, sh, ch, x, add -es: buses, dishes, sandwiches, boxes. After a consonant + y, change y to -ies: one baby, two babies.
teach.fa: بعد از s، sh، ch و x باید -es بگذارید: buses، dishes، sandwiches، boxes. بعد از حرف بی‌صدا + y، y می‌شود -ies: babies.

teach.en: Some plurals are irregular: child, children; man, men; woman, women; tooth, teeth; foot, feet; mouse, mice.
teach.fa: بعضی جمع‌ها بی‌قاعده‌اند: child/children، man/men، woman/women، tooth/teeth، foot/feet، mouse/mice.

examples.en: Brush your teeth, Nicola!
examples.fa: دندان‌هایت را مسواک بزن، نیکولا!

topics.title: a, an and the
topics.titleFa: a، an و the

teach.en: Use "a" or "an" for one thing when it's new or not special: a bus, an apple.
teach.fa: برای یک چیز وقتی تازه گفته می‌شود یا خاص نیست a یا an می‌گوییم: a bus، an apple.

teach.en: "An" goes before a vowel sound: an egg, an umbrella, an hour. "A" goes before other sounds: a dog, a uniform.
teach.fa: an قبل از صدای مصوت می‌آید: an egg، an umbrella، an hour. بقیه a: a dog، a uniform.

teach.en: Use "the" when we both know which one: the kitchen, the bus stop, the sun.
teach.fa: وقتی هر دو می‌دانیم کدام است the می‌گوییم: the kitchen، the bus stop، the sun.

examples.en: There's a cat in the garden. The cat is Biscuit!
examples.fa: یک گربه در باغچه است. آن گربه بیسکویت است!

examples.en: Can I have an orange juice, please?
examples.fa: یک آب‌پرتقال لطفاً؟

examples.en: Tom is a bus driver. He drives the number 38.
examples.fa: تام رانندهٔ اتوبوس است. او شمارهٔ ۳۸ را می‌راند.

topics.title: there is, there are
topics.titleFa: there is و there are

teach.en: Use "there is" (there's) for one thing and "there are" for more than one.
teach.fa: there is (there's) برای یک چیز و there are برای چند چیز.

teach.en: Negative: there isn't, there aren't. Question: Is there…? Are there…?
teach.fa: منفی: there isn't، there aren't. سؤال: Is there…? Are there…?

teach.en: We often use "a" with there is, and "some" or "any" with there are.
teach.fa: با there is معمولاً a و با there are معمولاً some یا any می‌آید.

examples.en: There's a bus stop near our house.
examples.fa: نزدیک خانهٔ ما یک ایستگاه اتوبوس هست.

examples.en: There are three bedrooms upstairs.
examples.fa: طبقهٔ بالا سه اتاق خواب هست.

examples.en: Is there a chemist on the high street?
examples.fa: در خیابان اصلی داروخانه هست؟

topics.title: "have got" and "has got"
topics.titleFa: have got و has got

teach.en: In Britain we often say "have got" to talk about things we own, family and illnesses.
teach.fa: در بریتانیا برای مالکیت، اعضای خانواده و بیماری‌ها اغلب می‌گوییم «have got».

teach.en: I've got, you've got, we've got, they've got. But for he, she and it: he's got, she's got, it's got.
teach.fa: I've got، you've got، we've got، they've got. اما برای he، she و it: he's got، she's got، it's got.

teach.en: Negative: I haven't got, she hasn't got. Question: Have you got…? Has he got…?
teach.fa: منفی: I haven't got، she hasn't got. سؤال: Have you got…? Has he got…?

examples.en: William has got ten toy buses.
examples.fa: ویلیام ده اتوبوس اسباب‌بازی دارد.

examples.fa: سرما خورده‌ام. دستمال کاغذی ندارم!

examples.en: Have you got a pen? Yes, I have.

topics.title: Present simple: I work, she works
topics.titleFa: حال ساده: I work، she works

teach.en: We use the present simple for habits, routines and facts: I get up at seven. Tom drives a bus.
teach.fa: حال ساده برای عادت‌ها، کارهای روزمره و واقعیت‌هاست: I get up at seven. Tom drives a bus.

teach.en: With he, she and it, add -s or -es: she works, he watches, it goes.
teach.fa: با he، she و it، -s یا -es اضافه کنید: she works، he watches، it goes.

teach.en: Negative: I don't like… / he doesn't like…. Questions: Do you…? Does she…? After "doesn't" and "does", the verb has no -s.
teach.fa: منفی: I don't like / he doesn't like. سؤال: Do you…? Does she…? بعد از doesn't و does فعل -s نمی‌گیرد.

topics.title: Present simple questions and negatives: do, does
topics.titleFa: سؤال و منفیِ حال ساده: do و does

teach.en: For questions we put "do" or "does" first: Do you like tea? Does she work here?
teach.fa: در سؤال do یا does را اول می‌گذاریم: Do you like tea? Does she work here?

teach.en: For negatives use don't or doesn't + the main verb: I don't drive. He doesn't eat meat.
teach.fa: برای منفی از don't یا doesn't + فعل اصلی استفاده کنید: I don't drive. He doesn't eat meat.

teach.en: After does and doesn't, the verb has no -s: Does he play? (not Does he plays?)
teach.fa: بعد از does و doesn't فعل s نمی‌گیرد: Does he play? (نه Does he plays?)

examples.en: Do you live near here?
examples.fa: نزدیک این‌جا زندگی می‌کنی؟

examples.en: Tom doesn't like football.
examples.fa: تام فوتبال دوست ندارد.

examples.en: Does the bus stop at the hospital?
examples.fa: اتوبوس جلوی بیمارستان می‌ایستد؟

topics.title: always, usually, sometimes, never
topics.titleFa: قیدهای تکرار: always، usually، sometimes، never

teach.en: Frequency words say how often: always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never.
teach.fa: قیدهای تکرار می‌گویند چقدر: always، usually، often، sometimes، rarely، never.

teach.en: They go before the main verb: I usually walk to work.
teach.fa: قبل از فعل اصلی می‌آیند: I usually walk to work.

teach.en: But they go after "be": She's always late.
teach.fa: اما بعد از be می‌آیند: She's always late.

examples.fa: همیشه ساعت چهار چای می‌خوریم.

topics.title: Question words: what, where, when, who, how
topics.titleFa: کلمات پرسشی: what، where، when، who، how

teach.en: Question words come first: What, Where, When, Who, Why, How, Which, Whose.
teach.fa: کلمات پرسشی اول جمله می‌آیند: What، Where، When، Who، Why، How، Which، Whose.

teach.en: With "be": Where is the station? With other verbs use do/does: Where do you live?
teach.fa: با be: Where is the station? با فعل‌های دیگر do/does: Where do you live?

teach.en: Useful pairs: How much (money), How many (things), How old, How long.
teach.fa: ترکیب‌های مفید: How much (پول)، How many (تعداد)، How old (سن)، How long (مدت).

topics.title: can and can't
topics.titleFa: can و can't

teach.en: Use "can" for ability and permission: I can swim. Can I have a biscuit?
teach.fa: can برای توانایی و اجازه است: I can swim. Can I have a biscuit?

teach.en: "Can" is the same for everyone: I can, she can, they can. Never add -s, and never add "to": she can drive.
teach.fa: can برای همه یکی است: I can، she can، they can. هیچ‌وقت -s یا to نمی‌گیرد: she can drive.

teach.en: Negative: can't. Question: Can you…? In British English "can't" sounds like "carnt".
teach.fa: منفی: can't. سؤال: Can you…? در لهجهٔ بریتانیایی can't شبیه «کانت» تلفظ می‌شود.

examples.fa: می‌توانم اینجا بنشینم، لطفاً؟

topics.title: Imperatives: Sit down! Don't run!
topics.titleFa: امری: Sit down! Don't run!

teach.en: To tell someone what to do, use the verb on its own: Come in. Sit down.
teach.fa: برای گفتن این‌که کسی چه کند، فعل را به‌تنهایی به کار ببرید: Come in. Sit down.

teach.en: To say what not to do, put "Don't" first: Don't touch that!
teach.fa: برای منع، Don't را اول بگذارید: Don't touch that!

teach.en: In Britain, add "please" to sound polite: Please take a seat.
teach.fa: در بریتانیا برای مؤدبانه بودن please اضافه کنید: Please take a seat.

topics.title: in, on, at for time and place
topics.titleFa: حروف اضافهٔ in، on، at برای زمان و مکان

teach.en: Time: "at" for clock times (at six), "on" for days and dates (on Monday), "in" for months, years and seasons (in May).
teach.fa: زمان: at برای ساعت (at six)، on برای روز و تاریخ (on Monday)، in برای ماه، سال و فصل (in May).

teach.en: Place: "in" for inside (in the kitchen), "on" for a surface (on the table), "at" for a point or event (at the bus stop, at work).
teach.fa: مکان: in برای داخل (in the kitchen)، on برای روی سطح (on the table)، at برای یک نقطه یا رویداد (at the bus stop، at work).

teach.en: Say "at the weekend" and "at night" in British English.
teach.fa: در انگلیسی بریتانیایی می‌گوییم at the weekend و at night.

topics.title: Object pronouns: me, him, her, us, them
topics.titleFa: ضمایر مفعولی: me، him، her، us، them

teach.en: Subject pronouns do the action: I, you, he, she, it, we, they.
teach.fa: ضمایر فاعلی کار را انجام می‌دهند: I، you، he، she، it، we، they.

teach.en: Object pronouns come after a verb or a preposition: me, you, him, her, it, us, them.
teach.fa: ضمایر مفعولی بعد از فعل یا حرف اضافه می‌آیند: me، you، him، her، it، us، them.

teach.en: So we say "Call me!" and "Come with us", not "Call I".
teach.fa: پس می‌گوییم Call me! و Come with us، نه Call I.

teach.fa: بعضی فعل‌ها to + فعل می‌گیرند: want، need، decide، hope، plan، would like. I want to learn.

teach.en: Some verbs take -ing: enjoy, mind, finish, don't mind, can't stand. I enjoy cooking.
teach.fa: بعضی فعل‌ها ing می‌گیرند: enjoy، mind، finish، can't stand. I enjoy cooking.

teach.en: Like, love and hate can take either: I like swimming. I like to swim.
teach.fa: like، love و hate هر دو را می‌پذیرند: I like swimming. I like to swim.

examples.en: I need to buy some stamps.
examples.fa: باید تمبر بخرم.

examples.fa: تام از راندن اتوبوسش لذت می‌برد.

topics.title: Present perfect: ever, never, just, already, yet
topics.titleFa: حال کامل: ever، never، just، already، yet

teach.en: Use the present perfect for life experience and for past actions that matter now: I've been to Scotland. I've lost my keys!
teach.fa: حال کامل برای تجربه‌های زندگی و کارهای گذشته‌ای است که الان مهم‌اند: I've been to Scotland. I've lost my keys!

teach.en: Make it with have or has + the past participle: I've seen, she's finished, they haven't eaten.
teach.fa: با have/has + اسم مفعول ساخته می‌شود: I've seen، she's finished، they haven't eaten.

teach.en: "Just" means a moment ago, "already" means sooner than expected, and "yet" goes at the end of questions and negatives: Have you finished yet?
teach.fa: just یعنی همین الان، already یعنی زودتر از انتظار، و yet در آخر سؤال و منفی می‌آید: Have you finished yet?

examples.en: Have you ever been to Edinburgh?
examples.fa: تا حالا ادینبرو رفته‌ای؟

examples.en: William has just broken a mug.
examples.fa: ویلیام همین الان یک لیوان را شکست.

examples.en: I haven't done the washing-up yet.
examples.fa: هنوز ظرف‌ها را نشسته‌ام.

Have you ___ eaten haggis?

answers: I've never seen the sea in winter.
I've seen never the sea in winter.
I never have seen the sea in winter.

answers: Tom has lost his bus pass again.

answers: Have you packed your bag yet?

answers: Have you ever met Mrs Patel?

answers: She has not finished her tea.

topics.title: Present perfect or past simple?
topics.titleFa: حال کامل یا گذشتهٔ ساده؟

teach.en: Past simple for a finished time we name: yesterday, last year, in 2015, when I was a child.
teach.fa: گذشتهٔ ساده برای زمانی تمام‌شده که اسمش را می‌آوریم: yesterday، last year، in 2015.

teach.en: Present perfect when the time isn't finished or isn't said: today, this week, ever, recently.
teach.fa: حال کامل وقتی زمان تمام نشده یا گفته نمی‌شود: today، this week، ever، recently.

teach.en: So we say "I've been to Wales" but "I went to Wales last summer". Never "I've been there last summer".
teach.fa: پس می‌گوییم I've been to Wales ولی I went to Wales last summer.

examples.en: I've worked here for six years.
examples.fa: شش سال است که اینجا کار می‌کنم.

examples.en: Tom started driving buses in 2012.
examples.fa: تام از سال ۲۰۱۲ رانندگی اتوبوس را شروع کرد.

examples.en: Have you seen Biscuit this morning?
examples.fa: امروز صبح بیسکویت را دیده‌ای؟

answers: She lived in Leeds when she was a child.

answers: Ryan has known Sam since primary school.

answers: We lived here since 2018 until now.

topics.title: Present perfect continuous: I've been waiting for…
topics.titleFa: حال کامل استمراری: I've been waiting for…

teach.en: The present perfect continuous is have/has been + -ing. It's for an activity that started in the past and is still going on, or has just stopped.
teach.fa: حال کامل استمراری = have/has been + ing؛ برای کاری که از گذشته شروع شده و هنوز ادامه دارد یا تازه تمام شده.

teach.en: Use "for" with a period (for two hours) and "since" with a starting point (since nine o'clock).
teach.fa: for با مدت (for two hours) و since با نقطهٔ شروع (since nine o'clock).

teach.en: It also explains present evidence: I'm tired because I've been running.
teach.fa: علت وضع فعلی را هم توضیح می‌دهد: I'm tired because I've been running.

examples.en: I've been waiting for the bus for twenty minutes.
examples.fa: بیست دقیقه است منتظر اتوبوسم.

examples.en: Leslie has been working at the nursery since March.
examples.fa: لزلی از مارس در مهدکودک کار می‌کند.

examples.en: Your eyes are red. Have you been crying?
examples.fa: چشم‌هایت قرمز است. گریه کرده‌ای؟

practice.prompt: We've been living here ___ 2019.
She's been learning English ___ six months.
How long have you ___ waiting?
Which sentence is correct?
answers: It has been raining all day.

practice.prompt: How long have you been working here?
answers: How long have you been working here?

answers: I have been reading since two.
I've been reading since two o'clock.

I'm hot because I've been ___ in the garden.

They've been talking for hours.
Make it a question: "You've been studying."

topics.title: Past perfect: It had already left
topics.titleFa: گذشتهٔ کامل: It had already left

teach.en: The past perfect is had + past participle. It shows which past action happened first.
teach.fa: گذشتهٔ کامل = had + اسم مفعول؛ نشان می‌دهد کدام کار در گذشته زودتر اتفاق افتاده.

teach.en: When I got to the station, the train had left. (First the train left, then I arrived.)
teach.fa: When I got to the station, the train had left. (اول قطار رفت، بعد من رسیدم.)

teach.en: It's common with already, just, before, by the time and after.
teach.fa: با already، just، before، by the time و after رایج است.

examples.en: By the time we arrived, the film had started.
examples.fa: تا رسیدیم فیلم شروع شده بود.

examples.en: I'd never seen snow before I came to England.
examples.fa: قبل از آمدن به انگلیس هیچ‌وقت برف ندیده بودم.

examples.en: She was upset because she had lost her purse.
examples.fa: ناراحت بود چون کیف پولش را گم کرده بود.

answers: When I reached the stop, the bus had left.

topics.title: Future forms: will, going to, present continuous
topics.titleFa: زمان آینده: will، going to و حال استمراری

teach.en: "Going to" is for plans you've already made: I'm going to paint the kitchen.
teach.fa: going to برای برنامه‌هایی است که از قبل گرفته‌اید: I'm going to paint the kitchen.

teach.en: "Will" is for quick decisions, offers and predictions: It's cold. I'll make some tea. I think it'll rain.
teach.fa: will برای تصمیم لحظه‌ای، پیشنهاد کمک و پیش‌بینی: I'll make some tea. I think it'll rain.

teach.en: The present continuous is for fixed arrangements with a time: We're seeing the dentist on Friday.
teach.fa: حال استمراری برای قرارهای قطعی با زمان مشخص: We're seeing the dentist on Friday.

examples.en: Don't worry, I'll pick you up from the station.
examples.fa: نگران نباش، از ایستگاه دنبالت می‌آیم.

examples.en: Ryan's going to learn to drive next year.
examples.fa: رایان سال بعد قرار است رانندگی یاد بگیرد.

examples.en: We're having a barbecue on Saturday.
examples.fa: شنبه کباب‌پزی داریم.

answers: Tom is working late on Thursday.

test.prompt: Make it negative: "She's going to come."
answers: She is not going to come.

topics.title: Zero conditional: If you heat ice, it melts
topics.titleFa: شرطی صفر: If you heat ice, it melts

teach.en: The zero conditional is for things that are always true: If + present simple, present simple.
teach.fa: شرطی صفر برای چیزهایی است که همیشه درست‌اند: If + حال ساده، حال ساده.

teach.en: If you heat ice, it melts. If I drink coffee at night, I can't sleep.
teach.fa: If you heat ice, it melts. If I drink coffee at night, I can't sleep.

teach.en: "When" often means the same here: When it rains, the roads get busy.
teach.fa: این‌جا when اغلب همان معنا را دارد: When it rains, the roads get busy.

examples.en: If you press this button, the door opens.
examples.fa: اگر این دکمه را فشار دهید، در باز می‌شود.

examples.en: If you don't water plants, they die.
examples.fa: اگر به گیاهان آب ندهید، می‌میرند.

topics.title: First conditional: If it rains, we'll…
topics.titleFa: شرطی نوع اول: If it rains, we'll…

teach.en: Use the first conditional for real possibilities in the future: If it rains, we'll stay in.
teach.fa: شرطی نوع اول برای احتمال واقعی در آینده: If it rains, we'll stay in.

teach.en: The pattern is If + present simple, then will + verb. Don't put "will" after "if": If you hurry, not If you will hurry.
teach.fa: الگو: If + حال ساده، سپس will + فعل. بعد از if از will استفاده نکنید.

teach.en: "Unless" means "if not": We'll be late unless we leave now.
teach.fa: unless یعنی «اگر نه»: We'll be late unless we leave now.

examples.en: If you finish your tea, you can have pudding.
examples.fa: اگر شامت را تمام کنی، می‌توانی دسر بخوری.

examples.en: If Biscuit sees a bird, she'll sit at the window all day.
examples.fa: اگر بیسکویت یک پرنده ببیند، تمام روز پشت پنجره می‌نشیند.

examples.en: I won't go unless you come with me.
examples.fa: نمی‌روم مگر اینکه تو هم با من بیایی.

answers: If we leave now, we'll catch the bus.

topics.title: Modals: have to, must, should, might
topics.titleFa: فعل‌های وجهی: have to، must، should، might

teach.en: "Have to" and "must" mean it's necessary: I have to work on Saturday. You must wear a seat belt.
teach.fa: have to و must یعنی لازم است: I have to work on Saturday.

teach.en: "Don't have to" means it isn't necessary, but "mustn't" means don't do it: You don't have to come. You mustn't smoke here.
teach.fa: don't have to یعنی لازم نیست، ولی mustn't یعنی ممنوع است.

teach.en: "Should" gives advice, and "might" or "could" means maybe: You should see a GP. It might snow tonight.
teach.fa: should برای توصیه، might و could یعنی شاید: You should see a GP. It might snow tonight.

examples.en: You don't have to wear school uniform on Friday.
examples.fa: جمعه لازم نیست لباس مدرسه بپوشی.

examples.en: You mustn't feed Biscuit chocolate.
examples.fa: نباید به بیسکویت شکلات بدهی.

examples.en: Take a coat. It might get chilly later.
examples.fa: کت بردار. شاید بعداً سرد شود.

topics.title: could, be able to, manage to
topics.titleFa: could، be able to و manage to

teach.en: "Could" is the past of "can" for general ability: I could swim when I was five.
teach.fa: could گذشتهٔ can برای توانایی کلی است: I could swim when I was five.

teach.en: For one success in a difficult situation, use "was able to" or "managed to": The fire spread, but everyone was able to escape.
teach.fa: برای موفقیت در یک موقعیت سخت was able to یا managed to: everyone was able to escape.

teach.en: Use "be able to" in other tenses: I'll be able to help tomorrow. I haven't been able to sleep.
teach.fa: در زمان‌های دیگر be able to: I'll be able to help tomorrow. I haven't been able to sleep.

examples.en: I couldn't find a parking space.
examples.fa: جای پارک پیدا نکردم.

examples.en: She managed to pass her driving test first time.
examples.fa: توانست بار اول امتحان رانندگی‌اش را قبول شود.

examples.en: Will you be able to come on Saturday?
examples.fa: شنبه می‌توانی بیایی؟

answers: I'll be able to pay next week.

answers: Were you able to fix it?

answers: I won't be able to come tomorrow.

answers: After an hour I managed to find the keys.

topics.title: Relative clauses: who, which, that, where
topics.titleFa: جمله‌واره‌های موصولی: who، which، that، where

teach.en: Relative clauses tell us which person or thing we mean. Use "who" for people and "which" for things.
teach.fa: جمله‌وارهٔ موصولی می‌گوید منظورمان کدام شخص یا چیز است. who برای آدم و which برای چیز.

teach.en: "That" can replace who or which in these clauses: The woman that lives next door…
teach.fa: that می‌تواند جای who یا which بنشیند: The woman that lives next door…

teach.en: Use "where" for places and "whose" for possession: the town where I grew up; the man whose car was stolen.
teach.fa: where برای مکان و whose برای مالکیت: the town where I grew up؛ the man whose car was stolen.

examples.en: That's the doctor who helped my mum.
examples.fa: آن همان دکتری است که به مادرم کمک کرد.

examples.en: Is this the bus which goes to Hackney?
examples.fa: این همان اتوبوسی است که به هکنی می‌رود؟

examples.en: This is the café where we first met.
examples.fa: این کافه‌ای است که اولین بار همدیگر را دیدیم.

practice.prompt: The man ___ fixed our boiler was very friendly.
I lost the ring ___ my gran gave me.

answers: She's the teacher whose class won.

She's the teacher which class won.

practice.prompt: The flat that we rented was tiny.
answers: The flat that we rented was tiny.

practice.prompt: Join with "who": "I met a woman. She speaks five languages."
answers: I met a woman who speaks five languages.

test.prompt: The film ___ we watched was scary.

answers: This is the house where I was born.

test.prompt: Join with "which": "I bought a coat. It was in the sale."
answers: I bought a coat which was in the sale.
I bought a coat that was in the sale.

topics.title: Verb + -ing or to: stop, remember, try
topics.titleFa: فعل + ing یا to: stop، remember، try

teach.en: Some verbs change meaning with -ing or "to". "Remember doing" is a memory; "remember to do" is not forgetting a task.
teach.fa: بعضی فعل‌ها با ing یا to معنی‌شان فرق می‌کند. remember doing یعنی خاطره؛ remember to do یعنی فراموش نکردن کاری.

teach.en: "Stop doing" means you no longer do it; "stop to do" means you stop in order to do something.
teach.fa: stop doing یعنی دیگر انجامش ندهی؛ stop to do یعنی می‌ایستی تا کاری انجام دهی.

teach.en: "Try to do" is making an effort; "try doing" is testing a way to solve a problem.
teach.fa: try to do یعنی تلاش کردن؛ try doing یعنی امتحان کردن یک راه‌حل.

examples.en: Remember to lock the door!
examples.fa: یادت باشد در را قفل کنی!

examples.en: I remember meeting her at a wedding.
examples.fa: یادم است او را در یک عروسی دیدم.

examples.en: He stopped smoking last year.
examples.fa: پارسال سیگار را ترک کرد.

topics.title: -ed and -ing adjectives: bored or boring?
topics.titleFa: صفت‌های ed و ing: bored یا boring؟

teach.en: -ed adjectives describe how a person feels: I'm bored. I'm interested.
teach.fa: صفت‌های ed احساس شخص را توصیف می‌کنند: I'm bored. I'm interested.

teach.en: -ing adjectives describe the thing that causes the feeling: The film was boring. The news is interesting.
teach.fa: صفت‌های ing چیزی را توصیف می‌کنند که آن احساس را ایجاد می‌کند: The film was boring.

teach.en: Be careful: "I'm boring" means other people find you dull!

teach.en: A phrasal verb is a verb + a small word (up, off, on, out, after…). Together they have a new meaning.

topics.title: used to, would and be used to

teach.en: "Used to" is for past habits and states that aren't true now: I used to live in Leeds.

teach.en: "Would" can also describe past habits, but not states: Every summer we'd go to Skegness.

teach.en: "Be used to" or "get used to" + -ing means something is normal for you now: I'm used to driving on the left.

examples.en: Tom used to have long hair.

topics.title: Past perfect continuous: I'd been waiting for hours

teach.en: The past perfect continuous is had been + -ing. It shows an activity that continued up to a moment in the past.

topics.title: Future continuous and future perfect
topics.titleFa: آیندهٔ استمراری و آیندهٔ کامل

teach.en: The future continuous (will be + -ing) is an action in progress at a future time: This time tomorrow I'll be flying to Tehran.

topics.title: Second conditional: If I won, I would…

teach.fa: فعل + to: agree، offer، promise، refuse. فعل + مفعول + to: advise، ask، remind، warn.

teach.en: Verb + -ing: suggest, deny, admit, recommend. "Suggest" can also take "that": She suggested that we leave early.
teach.fa: فعل + ing: suggest، deny، admit، recommend. suggest با that هم می‌آید: She suggested that we leave early.

examples.en: The doctor advised me to rest.
examples.fa: دکتر به من توصیه کرد استراحت کنم.

examples.en: He denied taking the money.
examples.fa: انکار کرد که پول را برداشته.

examples.en: Leslie offered to drive us home.
examples.fa: لزلی پیشنهاد داد ما را به خانه برساند.

practice.prompt: She refused ___ the form.
Tom suggested ___ a taxi.
The landlord reminded us ___ the rent.
Which sentence is correct?
answers: He admitted to break the window.

practice.prompt: My teacher advised me to read more.
answers: My teacher advised me to read more.

practice.prompt: Report it with "promise": "I'll call you," he said. (He promised…)

test.prompt: She warned us ___ touch the oven.
They recommended ___ early.
Which reports "No, I didn't do it!"?
They agreed to meet on Friday.
answers: They agreed to meet on Friday.

test.prompt: Report it with "offer": "I'll help you move," Ryan said. (Ryan offered…)
answers: Ryan offered to help me move.
Ryan offered to help us move.

topics.title: Modals of deduction: must be, can't be, might have been
topics.titleFa: افعال وجهی استنباط: must be، can't be، might have been

teach.en: Use must, might/may/could and can't to say how sure you are. "Must" = I'm sure it's true. "Can't" = I'm sure it's not true.
teach.fa: با must، might/may/could و can't میزان اطمینان را بگویید. must = مطمئنم درست است؛ can't = مطمئنم درست نیست.

teach.en: For the present: She must be at work. It might be in the car. That can't be Tom — he's in Spain.
teach.fa: برای حال: She must be at work. It might be in the car. That can't be Tom.

teach.en: For the past, add "have" + past participle: He must have forgotten. They might have missed the train. She can't have seen us.
teach.fa: برای گذشته have + اسم مفعول: He must have forgotten. She can't have seen us.

examples.en: The lights are off. They must be asleep.
examples.fa: چراغ‌ها خاموش است. حتماً خوابند.

examples.en: I can't find my wallet. I might have left it at the café.
examples.fa: کیف پولم را پیدا نمی‌کنم. شاید در کافه جا گذاشته‌ام.

examples.en: You can't be hungry! You've just eaten.
examples.fa: امکان ندارد گرسنه باشی! تازه غذا خوردی.

practice.prompt: He's been running for an hour. He ___ be tired.
That ___ be Leslie's car. Hers is blue, and this one is red.
She didn't answer. She might have ___ asleep.
Which means "I'm sure it happened"?
You must have been really worried.
answers: You must have been really worried.

practice.prompt: Make it about the past: "He must be lost." (He must…)

test.prompt: I'm not sure where Ryan is. He ___ be at the gym.
The window's broken. Someone must have ___ it.
Which means "I'm sure it's not true"?
She can't have heard the doorbell.
answers: She can't have heard the doorbell.

test.prompt: Use "can't have": "I'm sure he didn't see it." (He…)

topics.title: should have, could have, would have
topics.titleFa: should have، could have، would have

teach.en: "Should have" + past participle is for regret or criticism about the past: I should have called you.
teach.fa: should have + اسم مفعول برای پشیمانی یا انتقاد دربارهٔ گذشته: I should have called you.

teach.en: "Could have" is a past possibility that didn't happen: You could have been hurt!
teach.fa: could have امکانی در گذشته که اتفاق نیفتاد: You could have been hurt!

teach.en: "Would have" imagines a different past: I would have come, but I was ill.
teach.fa: would have گذشته‌ای متفاوت را تصور می‌کند: I would have come, but I was ill.

examples.en: We should have booked a table.
examples.fa: باید میز رزرو می‌کردیم.

examples.en: You shouldn't have shouted at her.
examples.fa: نباید سرش داد می‌زدی.

examples.en: I could have walked, but it was raining.
examples.fa: می‌توانستم پیاده بروم، ولی باران می‌آمد.

practice.prompt: I failed the test. I ___ have studied more.
You ___ have told me! I'd have helped.
He shouldn't have ___ so much cake.
Which expresses regret?
answers: I should have listened to you.
I should listen to you yesterday.

practice.prompt: You should have seen his face!
answers: You should have seen his face!

practice.prompt: Express regret: "I didn't bring an umbrella." (I should…)
answers: I should have brought an umbrella.

test.prompt: I ___ have gone to the party, but I was working.
Be careful! You could have ___ yourself.
Which is a criticism?
We could have taken a taxi.
answers: We could have taken a taxi.

test.prompt: Express regret: "I was rude to her." (I shouldn't…)
answers: I shouldn't have been rude to her.
I should not have been rude to her.

topics.title: Non-defining relative clauses: My sister, who lives in Leeds, …
topics.titleFa: جمله‌وارهٔ موصولی توضیحی: My sister, who lives in Leeds, …

teach.en: Non-defining relative clauses add extra information. They go between commas, and the sentence still makes sense without them.
teach.fa: جمله‌وارهٔ موصولی توضیحی اطلاعات اضافه می‌دهد؛ بین ویرگول می‌آید و جمله بدون آن هم معنا دارد.

teach.en: Use who, which, whose or where — never "that" — in non-defining clauses.
teach.fa: در این نوع جمله‌واره who، which، whose یا where به کار ببرید، هرگز that.

teach.en: "Which" can refer to a whole idea: He was late again, which annoyed everyone.
teach.fa: which می‌تواند به کل یک فکر اشاره کند: He was late again, which annoyed everyone.

examples.en: My neighbour, who is a nurse, works nights.
examples.fa: همسایه‌ام که پرستار است، شب‌ها کار می‌کند.

examples.en: Manchester, where I studied, is a great city.
examples.fa: منچستر که آن‌جا درس خواندم، شهر خیلی خوبی است.

examples.en: The train was cancelled, which meant we missed the wedding.
examples.fa: قطار لغو شد و این یعنی عروسی را از دست دادیم.

practice.prompt: Mr Jenkins, ___ shop is on the corner, sells newspapers.
Our flat, ___ we bought in 2020, needs a new kitchen.
She passed her exam, ___ surprised everyone.
Which sentence is correct?
answers: My dad, who is seventy, still cycles.
My dad, that is seventy, still cycles.
My dad who is seventy, still cycles.

practice.prompt: Leeds, where my sister lives, is in Yorkshire.
answers: Leeds, where my sister lives, is in Yorkshire.

practice.prompt: Join with "who": "Mrs Patel is very kind. She runs the shop." (Mrs Patel, …)
answers: Mrs Patel, who runs the shop, is very kind.

test.prompt: The museum, ___ opened in 1890, is free.
Tom, ___ wife works at a nursery, drives a bus.
Which word can't start a non-defining clause?
It rained all day, which was disappointing.
answers: It rained all day, which was disappointing.

test.prompt: Join with "which": "The heating broke. It was annoying." (The heating broke, …)
answers: The heating broke, which was annoying.

topics.title: Contrast: although, despite, however, whereas
topics.titleFa: بیان تضاد: although، despite، however، whereas

teach.en: "Although" and "even though" are followed by a clause: Although it was cold, we went out.
teach.fa: بعد از although و even though یک جمله می‌آید: Although it was cold, we went out.

teach.en: "Despite" and "in spite of" are followed by a noun or -ing: Despite the cold, we went out. Despite feeling ill, she worked.
teach.fa: بعد از despite و in spite of اسم یا ing می‌آید: Despite the cold… / Despite feeling ill…

teach.en: "However" starts a new sentence, usually with a comma: It was cold. However, we went out. "Whereas" compares two facts.
teach.fa: however جملهٔ تازه را شروع می‌کند، معمولاً با ویرگول. whereas دو واقعیت را مقایسه می‌کند.

examples.en: Although the flat is small, it's very cosy.
examples.fa: با این‌که آپارتمان کوچک است، خیلی دنج است.

examples.en: Despite the traffic, we arrived on time.
examples.fa: با وجود ترافیک، سر وقت رسیدیم.

examples.en: I love tea, whereas my husband prefers coffee.
examples.fa: من چای دوست دارم، در حالی که شوهرم قهوه را ترجیح می‌دهد.

practice.prompt: ___ the rain, the match went ahead.
___ she's only six, Nicola can read well.
The job pays well. ___, the hours are long.
Which sentence is correct?
answers: In spite of being tired, he kept going.
In spite of he was tired, he kept going.
In spite being tired, he kept going.

practice.prompt: Although I was nervous, the interview went well.
answers: Although I was nervous, the interview went well.

practice.prompt: Use "Despite": "Although it was expensive, we bought it." (Despite…)
answers: Despite the price, we bought it.
Despite it being expensive, we bought it.
Despite the cost, we bought it.

test.prompt: ___ I studied hard, I failed.
Ryan likes football, ___ William prefers buses.
Which is followed by a noun or -ing?
Despite the delay, everyone stayed calm.
answers: Despite the delay, everyone stayed calm.

test.prompt: Use "However": "The hotel was nice but the food was awful." (The hotel was nice. However, …)
answers: The hotel was nice. However, the food was awful.

topics.title: Participle clauses: Walking home, I saw…
topics.titleFa: جمله‌واره‌های وصفی: Walking home, I saw…

teach.en: Participle clauses make writing shorter. An -ing clause can replace "when/while/because + subject + verb": Walking home, I saw a fox.
teach.fa: جمله‌وارهٔ وصفی نوشته را کوتاه‌تر می‌کند. ing می‌تواند جای when/while/because + فاعل + فعل بنشیند: Walking home, I saw a fox.

teach.en: "Having + past participle" shows that one action finished before another: Having finished work, she went home.
teach.fa: Having + اسم مفعول نشان می‌دهد کاری قبل از دیگری تمام شده: Having finished work, she went home.

teach.en: A past participle can have a passive meaning: Built in 1890, the station is now a museum.
teach.fa: اسم مفعول می‌تواند معنای مجهول داشته باشد: Built in 1890, the station is now a museum.

examples.en: Feeling tired, Leslie went to bed early.
examples.fa: لزلی که خسته بود، زود خوابید.

examples.en: Having read the letter, he called the council.
examples.fa: بعد از خواندن نامه، به شورای شهر زنگ زد.

examples.en: Made in Yorkshire, these biscuits are famous.
examples.fa: این بیسکویت‌ها که در یورکشایر ساخته می‌شوند، معروف‌اند.

practice.prompt: ___ the door, she heard a noise.
Having ___ the film before, I knew the ending.
___ by a famous architect, the building is beautiful.
Which sentence is correct?
answers: Not knowing the way, we used a map.
Not know the way, we used a map.
Knowing not the way, we used a map.

practice.prompt: Having paid the bill, we left.
answers: Having paid the bill, we left.

practice.prompt: Shorten it: "Because she felt ill, she stayed at home." (Feeling…)
answers: Feeling ill, she stayed at home.

test.prompt: ___ in a hurry, I forgot my phone.
Having ___ lunch, they went for a walk.
Which shows that one action finished first?
answers: Having parked the car, he went inside.
Parking the car, he went inside tomorrow.
Park the car, he went inside.

test.prompt: Looking out of the window, I saw snow.
answers: Looking out of the window, I saw snow.

test.prompt: Shorten it: "After he had finished his homework, he played games." (Having…)
answers: Having finished his homework, he played games.

topics.title: Future perfect continuous and the future in the past
topics.titleFa: آیندهٔ کامل استمراری و «آینده در گذشته»

teach.en: The future perfect continuous (will have been + -ing) looks back from a future point at how long something has lasted: By May, I'll have been living here for ten years.
teach.fa: آیندهٔ کامل استمراری (will have been + ing) از نقطه‌ای در آینده به مدت یک کار نگاه می‌کند: By May, I'll have been living here for ten years.

teach.en: The future in the past describes what was planned or expected at an earlier time: was going to, would, was about to, was to.
teach.fa: «آینده در گذشته» آنچه را در گذشته برنامه‌ریزی یا انتظار می‌رفت بیان می‌کند: was going to، would، was about to، was to.

teach.en: "Was going to" often shows a plan that didn't happen: I was going to call you, but I forgot.
teach.fa: was going to اغلب برنامه‌ای را نشان می‌دهد که انجام نشد: I was going to call you, but I forgot.

examples.en: In June, Tom will have been driving buses for twenty years.
examples.fa: در ژوئن، بیست سال است که تام اتوبوس می‌راند.

examples.en: I knew she would be a brilliant nurse.
examples.fa: می‌دانستم پرستار فوق‌العاده‌ای می‌شود.

examples.en: We were about to leave when the phone rang.
examples.fa: داشتیم می‌رفتیم که تلفن زنگ زد.

practice.prompt: By the time he retires, he'll have been ___ there for forty years.
I ___ going to tell you, but you found out first.
She promised she ___ write every week.
Which shows a plan that didn't happen?
answers: We were going to buy a house, but prices went up.

practice.prompt: I was about to call you.
answers: I was about to call you.

practice.prompt: Use the future perfect continuous: "I started this job in 2020. In 2030…" (In 2030 I'll…)
answers: In 2030 I'll have been doing this job for ten years.
In 2030 I will have been doing this job for ten years.

test.prompt: Little did they know that they ___ never see each other again.
By midnight we'll have been ___ for twelve hours.
Which is the future in the past?
answers: He said he would be late.
He says he will be late.

test.prompt: The meeting was to start at nine.
answers: The meeting was to start at nine.

test.prompt: Use "was going to": "I planned to cook, but I was too tired." (I was going to…)
answers: I was going to cook, but I was too tired.

topics.title: Mixed conditionals
topics.titleFa: شرطی‌های ترکیبی

teach.en: Mixed conditionals join two times. A past condition with a present result: If I'd taken that job, I'd be living in Manchester now.
teach.fa: شرطی ترکیبی دو زمان را به هم وصل می‌کند. شرط گذشته با نتیجهٔ حال: If I'd taken that job, I'd be living in Manchester now.

teach.en: Or a present state with a past result: If I weren't so shy, I would have spoken to her.
teach.fa: یا حالت حال با نتیجهٔ گذشته: If I weren't so shy, I would have spoken to her.

teach.en: Check the time of each half: "had + past participle" looks back, "would + verb" is about now, "would have + past participle" is about the past.
teach.fa: زمان هر نیمه را بسنجید: had + اسم مفعول به گذشته نگاه می‌کند، would + فعل دربارهٔ حال است، would have + اسم مفعول دربارهٔ گذشته.

examples.en: If Tom hadn't missed that bus, he wouldn't have met Leslie, and Nicola wouldn't be here!
examples.fa: اگر تام آن اتوبوس را از دست نداده بود، لزلی را نمی‌دید و حالا نیکولا اینجا نبود!

examples.en: If I were better with money, I wouldn't have bought that sofa.
examples.fa: اگر حساب پول دستم بود، آن کاناپه را نمی‌خریدم.

examples.en: If Ryan had revised, he'd be on holiday now instead of resitting.
examples.fa: اگر رایان درس خوانده بود، حالا به‌جای امتحان مجدد در تعطیلات بود.

practice.prompt: If I had gone to bed earlier, I ___ so tired now.
If she ___ afraid of flying, she would have come to Spain with us.
If we'd bought that house, we ___ next door to Gran now.
Which is a past condition with a present result?
answers: If I'd learnt Welsh as a child, I'd speak it now.
If I learnt Welsh, I'd speak it.
If I learn Welsh, I'll speak it.

practice.prompt: If he had saved more, he would be retired now.
answers: If he had saved more, he would be retired now.

practice.prompt: Make it a mixed conditional: "I didn't eat breakfast, so I'm hungry now."
answers: If I had eaten breakfast, I wouldn't be hungry now.
If I'd eaten breakfast, I wouldn't be hungry now.
If I had eaten breakfast, I would not be hungry now.

test.prompt: If Leslie ___ the train, she'd be home by now.
If I were taller, I ___ joined the basketball team years ago.
Which sentence is correct?
answers: If you hadn't lost the map, we wouldn't be lost now.
If you didn't lose the map, we wouldn't be lost now.
If you hadn't lost the map, we won't be lost now.

test.prompt: If I spoke French, I would have applied.
answers: If I spoke French, I would have applied.

test.prompt: Make it a mixed conditional: "He isn't careful, so he broke the vase."
answers: If he were careful, he wouldn't have broken the vase.
If he was careful, he wouldn't have broken the vase.
If he were more careful, he wouldn't have broken the vase.

topics.title: wish, if only and it's time
topics.titleFa: wish، if only و it's time

teach.en: Wish or if only + past simple for present regrets: I wish I lived nearer the sea. If only it weren't raining.
teach.fa: wish یا if only + گذشتهٔ ساده برای حسرت دربارهٔ حال: I wish I lived nearer the sea.

teach.en: Wish + past perfect for past regrets: I wish I hadn't said that. Wish + would for annoying habits: I wish you'd stop tapping!
teach.fa: wish + ماضی بعید برای حسرت گذشته: I wish I hadn't said that. wish + would برای عادت‌های آزاردهنده: I wish you'd stop tapping!

teach.en: "It's time" or "It's high time" + past simple means it should happen now: It's high time we left.
teach.fa: It's (high) time + گذشتهٔ ساده یعنی وقتش رسیده: It's high time we left.

examples.en: I wish I had more time with the kids.
examples.fa: کاش وقت بیشتری با بچه‌ها داشتم.

examples.en: If only we'd booked a table!
examples.fa: کاش میز رزرو کرده بودیم!

examples.en: I wish Biscuit would stop sleeping on my clean washing.
examples.fa: کاش بیسکویت این‌قدر روی لباس‌های تمیزم نخوابد.

practice.prompt: I wish I ___ drive. The bus takes ages.
If only I ___ that last slice of cake. I feel awful.
It's high time you ___ your room, Ryan.
Which is about an annoying habit?
answers: I wish you would put the lid back on.
I wish you put the lid back on yesterday.
I wish you had put the lid back on.

practice.prompt: I wish we had gone to the beach.
answers: I wish we had gone to the beach.

practice.prompt: Make a wish about now: "I don't have a garden."
answers: I wish I had a garden.
If only I had a garden.

test.prompt: I wish it ___ so cold today.
She wishes she ___ the job. She regrets it now.
Which sentence is correct?
answers: It's time we will go home.

test.prompt: If only I knew the answer.
answers: If only I knew the answer.

test.prompt: Make a past regret with "wish": "I didn't bring an umbrella."
answers: I wish I had brought an umbrella.
I wish I'd brought an umbrella.

topics.title: Advanced modals: needn't have, be bound to, may well
topics.titleFa: افعال وجهی پیشرفته: needn't have، be bound to، may well

teach.en: "Needn't have" + past participle means you did something that wasn't necessary: I needn't have cooked — they'd already eaten.
teach.fa: needn't have + اسم مفعول یعنی کاری کردی که لازم نبود: I needn't have cooked.

teach.en: "Didn't need to" means it wasn't necessary, and usually you didn't do it: I didn't need to queue, so I went straight in.
teach.fa: didn't need to یعنی لازم نبود و معمولاً انجامش ندادی: I didn't need to queue.

teach.en: "Be bound to" means certain; "may/might well" means quite likely; "could hardly" means it was almost impossible.
teach.fa: be bound to یعنی حتماً؛ may/might well یعنی به احتمال زیاد؛ could hardly یعنی تقریباً ناممکن بود.

examples.en: You needn't have brought a present, but thank you!
examples.fa: لازم نبود هدیه بیاوری، ولی ممنون!

examples.en: It's bound to rain on the day of the barbecue.
examples.fa: حتماً روز کباب‌پزی باران می‌آید.

examples.en: The trains may well be delayed because of the strike.
examples.fa: به احتمال زیاد قطارها به خاطر اعتصاب تأخیر دارند.

practice.prompt: We ___ have rushed. The film started late.
He's always late. He's ___ to miss the start.
Prices may ___ go up again next year.
Which means you did something unnecessary?
answers: I needn't have taken a taxi.
I didn't need to take a taxi.

practice.prompt: You needn't have waited for me.
answers: You needn't have waited for me.

practice.prompt: Use "needn't have": "I bought milk, but there was plenty." (I…)
answers: I need not have bought milk.

test.prompt: I could ___ believe my eyes.
Don't worry, she's ___ to call soon.
Which means "quite likely"?
answers: The shop might well be closed.

test.prompt: It's bound to be busy on Saturday.
answers: It's bound to be busy on Saturday.

test.prompt: Use "may well": "It's quite likely that they'll win." (They…)

topics.title: Inversion: Never have I… / Not only…
topics.titleFa: وارونگی: Never have I… / Not only…

teach.en: After a negative or limiting word at the start, we swap the subject and auxiliary, like a question: Never have I seen such rain.
teach.fa: بعد از یک کلمهٔ منفی یا محدودکننده در ابتدای جمله، فاعل و فعل کمکی جابه‌جا می‌شوند، مثل سؤال: Never have I seen such rain.

teach.en: Common openers: Never, Rarely, Seldom, Not only… but also, Hardly… when, No sooner… than, Under no circumstances, Only then.
teach.fa: شروع‌کننده‌های رایج: Never، Rarely، Seldom، Not only… but also، Hardly… when، No sooner… than، Under no circumstances، Only then.

teach.en: If there's no auxiliary, add do, does or did: Rarely does Tom complain. It sounds formal or dramatic, so save it for speeches, writing and storytelling.
teach.fa: اگر فعل کمکی نیست do/does/did اضافه کنید: Rarely does Tom complain. لحنش رسمی یا نمایشی است؛ برای سخنرانی، نوشتن و قصه‌گویی.

examples.en: Never have I been so proud of this family.
examples.fa: هیچ‌وقت این‌قدر به این خانواده افتخار نکرده بودم.

examples.en: Not only did Ryan pass, but he also got the top mark.
examples.fa: رایان نه‌تنها قبول شد، بلکه بالاترین نمره را هم گرفت.

examples.en: No sooner had we sat down than the fire alarm went off.
examples.fa: تازه نشسته بودیم که آژیر آتش به صدا درآمد.

practice.prompt: Never ___ I tasted such a good scone.
Rarely ___ Leslie leave work before six.
Not only ___ late, but he also forgot the tickets.
Which sentence is correct?
answers: Under no circumstances should you open this door.
Under no circumstances you should open this door.
Under no circumstances should open you this door.

practice.prompt: Hardly had the match started when it began to pour.

topics.title: Cleft sentences: What I need is… / It was… who…
topics.titleFa: جملات شکافته: What I need is… / It was… who…

teach.en: Cleft sentences split one idea into two parts to point at the important bit: What I need is a cup of tea.
teach.fa: جملهٔ شکافته یک ایده را دو تکه می‌کند تا روی بخش مهم تأکید کند: What I need is a cup of tea.

teach.en: "It is / It was … that / who …" puts the focus at the front: It was Nicola who broke the vase, not William.
teach.fa: It is / It was … that / who … تأکید را جلو می‌آورد: It was Nicola who broke the vase, not William.

teach.en: Other useful patterns: All I want is…, The thing is…, The reason why… is…, What happened was…
teach.fa: الگوهای دیگر: All I want is…، The thing is…، The reason why… is…، What happened was…

examples.en: What I love about Hackney is the markets.
examples.fa: چیزی که در هکنی دوست دارم بازارهایش است.

examples.en: It was Tom who found Biscuit in the end.
examples.fa: آخرش تام بود که بیسکویت را پیدا کرد.

examples.en: All I want for my birthday is a quiet day.
examples.fa: تنها چیزی که برای تولدم می‌خواهم یک روز آرام است.

answers: What annoys me is the noise.

topics.title: Emphasis: do, auxiliaries and fronting
topics.titleFa: تأکید: do، فعل کمکی و جابه‌جایی

teach.en: Add do/does/did before the main verb to emphasise or contrast: I do like your hair! He did call — I just missed it.
teach.fa: برای تأکید یا تضاد do/does/did را قبل از فعل اصلی بگذارید: I do like your hair! He did call.

teach.en: Stress the auxiliary in speech to correct someone: "You haven't paid." "I HAVE paid!"
teach.fa: در گفتار برای اصلاح حرف دیگری روی فعل کمکی تأکید کنید: I HAVE paid!

teach.en: Fronting puts information first for focus: That film I'll never forget. Strange as it may seem, I enjoyed it.
teach.fa: جابه‌جایی اطلاعات را برای تأکید اول جمله می‌آورد: Strange as it may seem, I enjoyed it.

examples.en: I do understand how you feel.
examples.fa: واقعاً درک می‌کنم چه حسی داری.

examples.en: She did warn us about the traffic.
examples.fa: او واقعاً دربارهٔ ترافیک هشدار داده بود.

examples.en: Tired as I was, I finished the report.
examples.fa: با این‌که خسته بودم، گزارش را تمام کردم.

topics.title: Causative and advanced passive: have it done, is said to…
topics.titleFa: سببی و مجهول پیشرفته: have it done، is said to…

teach.en: Use have or get + object + past participle when someone else does a job for you: We're having the boiler serviced. I got my hair cut.
teach.fa: have یا get + مفعول + اسم مفعول وقتی کسی کاری را برایتان انجام می‌دهد: We're having the boiler serviced.

teach.en: The same pattern is used for bad things that happen to you: Tom had his bike stolen.
teach.fa: همین الگو برای اتفاق بدی است که برایتان می‌افتد: Tom had his bike stolen.

teach.en: For reports and rumours, use the passive with say, believe or think: It is said that… or He is believed to be… For the past: She is thought to have left.
teach.fa: برای گزارش و شایعه: It is said that… یا He is believed to be… برای گذشته: She is thought to have left.

examples.en: Leslie is getting her eyes tested on Friday.

examples.en: We had a new kitchen fitted last spring.
examples.fa: بهار گذشته آشپزخانهٔ جدید برایمان نصب کردند.

examples.en: The pub is said to be the oldest in London.
examples.fa: می‌گویند این میخانه قدیمی‌ترین میخانهٔ لندن است.

topics.title: Formal subjunctive: It's essential that he be…
topics.titleFa: وجه التزامی رسمی: It's essential that he be…

teach.en: After formal verbs and adjectives like insist, recommend, suggest, demand, essential and vital, British English often uses "should" + verb or the bare verb.
teach.fa: بعد از فعل‌ها و صفت‌های رسمی مثل insist، recommend، suggest، demand، essential و vital، در انگلیسی بریتانیایی should + فعل یا خودِ شکل سادهٔ فعل می‌آید.

teach.en: The bare verb doesn't change: It's vital that she attend (not attends). We insist that he be informed.
teach.fa: شکل ساده تغییر نمی‌کند: It's vital that she attend (نه attends). We insist that he be informed.

teach.en: In everyday British English "should" is common: The doctor recommended that I should rest.
teach.fa: در انگلیسی روزمرهٔ بریتانیایی should رایج است: The doctor recommended that I should rest.

topics.title: Ellipsis and substitution: I hope so, so do I, do so
topics.titleFa: حذف و جایگزینی: I hope so، so do I، do so

teach.en: To avoid repeating words, use "so" and "not" after think, hope, expect, suppose, I'm afraid: "Is it open?" "I think so." "I hope not."
teach.fa: برای پرهیز از تکرار، بعد از think، hope، expect، suppose و I'm afraid از so و not استفاده کنید: I think so. I hope not.

teach.en: Agree with "So do I / So am I" and "Neither do I / Nor can I". The auxiliary matches the first sentence.
teach.fa: برای موافقت So do I / So am I و Neither do I / Nor can I؛ فعل کمکی با جملهٔ اول هماهنگ است.

teach.en: "Do so" and "one/ones" replace a verb phrase or a noun: He promised to call, and he did so. I'd like the red one.
teach.fa: do so و one/ones جای گروه فعلی یا اسم می‌نشینند: he did so. I'd like the red one.

topics.title: Formal style: nominalisation and hedging
topics.titleFa: سبک رسمی: اسم‌سازی و احتیاط در بیان

teach.en: Formal writing often turns verbs into nouns (nominalisation): "We decided to close the branch" becomes "The decision was made to close the branch."
teach.fa: نوشتار رسمی اغلب فعل را به اسم تبدیل می‌کند: The decision was made to close the branch.

teach.en: Hedging makes claims softer and more careful: It would appear that…, This tends to…, It seems likely that…, There is some evidence that…
teach.fa: احتیاط در بیان ادعا را نرم‌تر می‌کند: It would appear that…، This tends to…، It seems likely that…

teach.en: Use these in reports, complaints and work emails, not in a chat with friends.
teach.fa: این‌ها را در گزارش، شکایت و ایمیل کاری به کار ببرید، نه در گپ دوستانه.
